offering_description.value: Provides hot-dip galvanizing and other metal coating services that protect steel from corrosion. Serves fabricators, contractors and manufacturers through plants that apply zinc coatings to customers' steel parts.

primary_services.value: hot-dip galvanizing; zinc coating; metal finishing

items.detail: steel fabricators, construction contractors, utilities and manufacturers
per-ton or per-piece fees for applying zinc coatings to customers' steel
coats steel supplied by customers and returns it to them for installation

geography_served.detail: plants across the United States and Canada

specialization.detail: hot-dip galvanizing and related metal coating services

items.detail: direct contracts with fabricators and contractors

regulatory_exposure.detail: medium: environmental permits for air emissions and wastewater from zinc processing, enforced by EPA and state agencies

offering_description.value: Manufactures electrical equipment and fittings, such as busway, enclosures and conduit fittings, sold to electrical contractors, utilities and industrial plants. Products are made in company plants and sold directly and through electrical distributors.

primary_products.value: electrical busway; conduit fittings; electrical enclosures; switchgear components

items.detail: electrical contractors, utilities, industrial plants and commercial building owners

end_markets.value: electrical construction; utilities; industrial manufacturing; commercial buildings

items.detail: electrical equipment and fittings sold to contractors and industrial customers
builds electrical products from purchased metal and components, sold to contractors and distributors

geography_served.detail: sales across the United States and Canada

specialization.detail: busway, conduit fittings, enclosures and switchgear components sold to electrical customers

items.detail: direct sales to large contractors and industrial accounts
electrical distributors that stock and resell products

regulatory_exposure.detail: low: product listing and electrical code standards such as UL and NEC rules apply, which are normal business requirements
